cases.title: A one-pair focus gets a walkthrough, not a demo that does the whole lesson

rubric.reason: Before the first explanation, Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 0.5, which is inside Glow's Blurriness pair (0 to 1 s), and the reply refers to it: "This frame is 0.5 s into Glow's Gaussian Blur animation."

No set_ease runs (demo_target is null, no_demo_reason single_pair), and Turn 2 hands the one pair back to the learner by name: "Ease Glow's Blurriness from 0 s to 1 s and say \"done\"", with a reason for not demoing it.

Turn 1 ends on a single question about the layer. Turn 2 is one short task: the frame, the linear-vs-eased idea, a one-line how-to, then "Ease Glow's Blurriness from 0 s to 1 s and say \"done\"", with a single demo alternative as the last sentence. It has no list, no Graph Editor tip and no lecture.
Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 0.5 s, inside the Glow Blurriness 0–1 s focus pair, and the reply refers to it: "This is Glow at 0.5 s, where its blur is softening the frame."

No set_ease runs, and turn 2 explains why it won't demo the only pair ("there'd be nothing left for you to do"), then asks the learner to act on the named pair: "Ease Glow's Blurriness from 0 s to 1 s and say 'done'."

Turn 2 runs slightly long (a sentence on why there's no demo, a three-sentence idea and a two-sentence how-to), but it carries one task with no list, Graph Editor tour or general easing lecture, ends on "Ease Glow's Blurriness from 0 s to 1 s and say 'done'", and puts one demo offer last.

Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 0.5 s, inside Glow's 0–1 s Blurriness pair, but the reply never mentions what the frame shows; it explains from the keyframe data only ("From 0 s to 1 s, Glow's Blurriness changes at the same speed the whole way").
Turn 2 makes no set_ease call, which fits no_demo_reason single_pair, and ends with "ease Glow's Blurriness yourself and say 'done'", naming the one remaining pair.

The turn 2 explanation gives a four-sentence step-by-step how-to ("press E… Open Gaussian Blur… Select both keys, then choose Animation > Keyframe Assistant > Easy Ease… The diamonds turn into hourglasses") where § 6 allows one sentence, and adds an aside on why it won't demo.
